title: Red Hat
post:
EX432 is a four-hour, hands-on exam. No multiple choice.

Red Hat's OpenShift exams EX432 and EX430 are hands-on, and EX436 is performance-based. You do the work on a live system.

Which Red Hat exam are you preparing for, and how do you practise the hands-on part?

Study guides link in the comments.

#RedHat #EX432

Practical tip: pick one exam objective each day and do it on a lab system, not only in your notes.
